episodes.title: My Mum Was Prisoned For Lying About My Health Condition
episodes.description:
References to child cruelty, mental health, sexual assault and self-harm

Was Lisa Hayden-Johnson’s son Matthew really Britain's sickest child? Doctors, police and family members tell their story behind the shocking deception.

Lisa’s world implodes as an unthinkable truth is revealed: Matthew’s illnesses are not as they seem. And while Matthew comes to terms with his new reality, the threat of prison hangs over Lisa. As the press dub Lisa’s ‘Britain’s most evil mother’ and the family rift deepens, Matthew confronts his past and meets the professionals who worked on his case, as he searches for the elusive truth. (EP2 and 3 of 3)

First shown: 20 Aug 2026
